attributes.name: list item separator
attributes.definition: The visual device used to divide or mark consecutive items in a list on the page.

values.definition: Thin horizontal lines or dividers between list items/rows.
Inline ornamental symbols (e.g. diamonds) separating items in a run.
Standard bullets or numbers marking each item.
No explicit separator, or a different treatment.

attributes.name: list item layout
attributes.definition: How the content of each list item is arranged.

values.definition: Each item is a full-width row with metadata (date, etc.) and title stacked or placed in columns.
Items run together horizontally in a single line or strip.
Simple vertical list of titles only.

attributes.name: list item trailing affordance
attributes.definition: A link or indicator placed at the end of each list item.

values.definition: A trailing arrow glyph in accent color.

attributes.name: list item metadata display
attributes.definition: How dates or other metadata appear in list items.

values.definition: Small accent-colored date placed above the title.

values.value: large day with small uppercase month
values.definition: Big bold day numeral paired with small uppercase month label.

attributes.name: list title typography
attributes.definition: Type treatment of list item titles.

codes.value: large day with small uppercase month
